title: Project Dynasty SMP
description: The designated modpack used for the Dynasty SMP
body:
Welcome player to the Dynasty SMP, a modded SMP designed around a presidents system where they get to add their own requested mods. If you've managed to successfully find and download this modpack, we hope to see you around the Minecraft server soon!

Starting out, we're a pretty lightweight modpack, but I made sure to include some great standout mods starting out such as:
- Create, which at this point requires no introduction.
- Create Aeronautics, a recently released mod that half-inspired me to actually start the server in the first place.
- Integrated Structures, combining blocks and elements from Create, Quark and Supplementaries to create all new amazing structures.
- Vanilla Backport, so we can get some of the stuff used in future drops, like Pale Gardens or Happy Ghasts (not all drops included, still to be updated).
